'''2011 Bespin Regionals Jenkins DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jenkins]] at [[2011 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' HDADTJ v7
* '''Username:''' Stinkins
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
